shared.--message-bg: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(243, 211, 114, 0.055), transparent 30%), linear-gradient(180deg, #171d2e 0%, #141927 100%)
shared.--header-bg: radial-gradient(120% 220% at 50% -80%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--rail-glow) 9%, transparent), transparent 55%), linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-raised) 88%, var(--surface-sidebar)), var(--surface-raised))
shared.--composer-bg: radial-gradient(120% 200% at 50% 120%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--rail-glow) 6%, transparent), transparent 58%), linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-raised) 90%, var(--surface-sidebar)), var(--surface-raised))
shared.--topic-bg: radial-gradient(90% 150% at 0% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--rail-glow) 12%, transparent), transparent 52%), linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-raised) 86%, var(--surface-sidebar)), var(--surface-raised))
shared.--shadow-raised: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04), 0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shadow) 22%, transparent), 0 10px 30px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shadow) 28%, transparent)
shared.--star-warm: color-mix(in srgb, var(--star-warm-src, transparent) var(--atmosphere-strength, 100%), transparent)
shared.--star-cool: color-mix(in srgb, var(--star-cool-src, transparent) var(--atmosphere-strength, 100%), transparent)
shared.--star-white: color-mix(in srgb, var(--star-white-src, transparent) var(--atmosphere-strength, 100%), transparent)
shared.--nebula: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nebula-src, transparent) var(--atmosphere-strength, 100%), transparent)

nebula.--message-bg: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.08), transparent 30%), linear-gradient(180deg, #050914 0%, #02050b 100%)

dim.--message-bg: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(155, 108, 255, 0.07), transparent 32%), linear-gradient(180deg, #10192a 0%, #0d1523 100%)

tokyo-night.--message-bg: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(122, 162, 247, 0.08), transparent 32%), linear-gradient(180deg, #1d2131 0%, #181a27 100%)

hackerman.--sidebar-bg: radial-gradient(120% 46% at 50% 104%, color-mix(in srgb, rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.16) var(--atmosphere-strength, 100%), transparent), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(180deg, #041404 0%, #030d03 58%, #020902 100%)
hackerman.--message-bg: radial-gradient(circle at 8% 0%, rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.07), transparent 30%), radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(0, 255, 208, 0.03), transparent 28%), linear-gradient(180deg, #030b03 0%, #010501 100%)
